title: Yale YRD210 PB DB: explaining battery normalization

scope_notes: The selected ZHA signature requires manufacturer, model and the full endpoint/cluster signature; the selected Zigbee2MQTT definition matches only the model string.
No physical device was inspected; firmware remains unknown.
The official YRD210 manual is family context. It does not establish exact firmware/signature applicability or the raw Zigbee battery scale.

This case is distinct from the YRD156 Z-Wave device. The associated lock-state comparison is included to preserve the complete referenced device record; battery normalization is the first investigation.

author: github:@infinitywings

features.title: Battery normalization
features.summary: The manual describes a local low-battery warning. Two upstream implementations adapt a battery value at different layers. Raw reports and final platform values are still needed to explain whether those paths agree for a particular firmware and signature.

implementation_notes.decision: Keep the manual's local battery warning separate from a numeric platform percentage.
implementation_notes.rationale: The inspected manual explains the warning indicator and replacement batteries, but supplies no value scale for the Zigbee battery attribute. It provides context rather than a numeric binding.
conditions: Family applicability only; no exact firmware, full signature or raw-scale claim follows from the manual.
The upstream PDF is referenced by URL and an inspected digest; it is not included in this package.

implementation_notes.decision: Document ZHA's doubling at the cluster attribute stage.
implementation_notes.rationale: The pinned quirk selects DoublingPowerConfigurationCluster, whose battery_percentage_remaining update multiplies attribute 0x0021 by two. This describes an intermediate value; the final Home Assistant entity pipeline has not been traced in this record.
conditions: The exact manufacturer/model and full endpoint/cluster signature must select this quirk.
Do not infer that the displayed entity percentage is doubled or copy this adjustment into another layer without tracing that layer.

implementation_notes.decision: Document Zigbee2MQTT's skipped default halving at the converter stage.
implementation_notes.rationale: The pinned model entry sets dontDividePercentage to true. The selected converter branch retains the reported percentage instead of applying its default divide-by-two step. This does not contradict a cluster-level adjustment followed by different downstream processing.
conditions: The selected definition uses a model-string matcher; manufacturer equality is not an enforced constraint there.
The percentage must exist and be below 255, and voltageToPercentage must be absent for the cited branch.
Source inspection did not execute the converter, test a physical lock or establish cross-platform equivalence.

test_plan.question: For an identified device and firmware, how does an observed raw battery attribute become the platform's displayed percentage?
procedure: On an already configured device you control, record public manufacturer/model identifiers, firmware if available, protocol, full endpoint/cluster signature and installed platform/driver versions.

During ordinary reporting, capture a sanitized battery attribute value and its attribute identifier, the relevant intermediate conversion if visible, and the final displayed value for the same report/time.

Identify which implementation path the installed version selected, distinguish measured values from deductions, and repeat only as needed to describe normal reporting. No driver patch or device re-pairing is requested.
Submit expected and actual values, time, repetition count and limitations. Keep differences between separate devices or platforms explicit rather than treating them as the same controlled execution.
requested_evidence: Public model/signature, firmware or explicit unknown, and exact integration/converter revisions.
Sanitized raw and displayed values with enough timing context to associate them; no household/network identifiers or credentials.
Any unobservable intermediate stage and whether the result supports, contradicts or leaves the proposed explanation unresolved.

gaps: No physical-device observations or executed simulations have been submitted.
No manufacturer definition of the raw battery attribute scale for the exact Zigbee module/firmware has been found.
The complete ZHA to Home Assistant entity normalization path is not yet documented.
Cross-platform numerical equivalence, low-battery thresholds, error/sentinel propagation and applicability across firmware remain unresolved.

features.title: Lock-state context
features.summary: The referenced device also carries a bounded comparison of ZHA's cluster declaration and Zigbee2MQTT's command/state exposure. It is retained as context, with no complete semantic mapping or hardware result.

implementation_notes.decision: Preserve command exposure and reported lock state as different declarations.
implementation_notes.rationale: The pinned ZHA quirk declares a DoorLock cluster. Zigbee2MQTT separately exposes a command-capable state field and a reported lock_state field with a not_fully_locked value. These declarations alone cannot establish identical runtime behavior.
conditions: Do not collapse partially locked or unknown states into a successful requested command.
The downstream Home Assistant lock entity is not traced here; no SDF binding or lock-operation experiment is proposed by this bundle.

gaps: The source comparison remains candidate, without an independent review, full downstream state trace or physical-device observation.

history.summary: First candidate bundle: preserve the existing device/source/corroboration records, add official manual context, explain battery adaptation layers, and invite a scoped observation. No experiment or independent review has been added.

limitations: Candidate draft format and content prepared for public review under https://github.com/edgeloom-oss/edgeloom/issues/63 . Canonical identifies the maintained catalog snapshot, not a manufacturer certification or exclusive account of device behavior.
Firmware, physical behavior and exact platform applicability remain unconfirmed. No SDF binding or new driver implementation is included.
The package includes catalog-authored metadata and explanations, not the manual, upstream source code, executed upstream fixtures or telemetry.

New bundle text and document metadata were prepared with Codex assistance under github:@infinitywings's direction. This is founder-contributed source research and curation, not independent review or an actual hardware report.
Referenced legacy records are included unchanged; their source maturity and candidate lifecycle are not promoted by package validation or publication.
